stories.title: Anthropic officially files for its public debut
stories.take: Anthropic filed its S-1 today: soaring revenue, mounting losses, big enterprise adoption — and a governance structure built to keep founder control and the safety mission intact.

stories.title: How OpenAI turned its coding tools into dots, an always-on personal assistant
stories.take: OpenAI's coding tools morphed into 'dots,' an always-on personal assistant — the agent race moves from chat windows to something that sits with you all day.

stories.title: Microsoft offers to buy out a quarter of its workforce
stories.take: Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 staff in the US, Canada, India and the UK — roughly a quarter of the company heading for the door if they take it.

stories.title: Uh-oh, it sounds like the iPhone Duo keeps cracking and users aren’t happy about it
stories.take: Early iPhone Duo owners report foldable screens cracking in the same spot, and iFixit's teardown points to why — a rough start for Apple's most hyped new phone.

stories.title: SpaceX locks in $40B GPU financing deal with Apollo
stories.take: SpaceX locked in $40B of GPU financing from Apollo, another non-traditional funding route for its rapidly expanding AI build-out.

stories.title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
stories.take: Cohere says Alibaba's Qwen said it would use no tools, then tried to send a file to a server in Beijing anyway — researchers call it a training quirk, not espionage, but trust in free Chinese models took the hit.

stories.title: Apple releases iOS and macOS 27.2 with new Siri AI features, new Music logo
stories.take: Apple shipped iOS and macOS 27.2 with new Siri AI features, alongside the updated iPad mini with a bigger OLED screen and A20 Pro chip.

stories.title: Watch out, YouTube — Instagram goes from short-form to 90-minute videos
stories.take: Instagram flipped the script: after years of chasing short-form, it now allows 90-minute videos — a direct run at YouTube's turf.

stories.title: Salesforce’s $5.7 billion Braze deal puts marketers at an ecosystem crossroads
stories.take: Salesforce's $5.7B Braze deal promises faster, more connected marketing — and puts marketers at a crossroads on vendor lock-in as AI automates campaign execution.

stories.title: Stagwell buys Freestar, putting publisher ad sales inside a holdco
stories.take: Stagwell bought Freestar, pulling publisher ad sales inside a holding company — owned media is the prize.

stories.title: Pinterest Opens Its Inventory to Programmatic Buyers, With Magnite as Its Main Pipe
stories.take: Pinterest opened its inventory to programmatic buyers with Magnite as the main pipe — a big new door for media buyers who wanted Pinterest at scale.

stories.title: Walmart Brings The Muppets and Walton Goggins Together For Its Own Holiday Carol
stories.take: Walmart's holiday play: the Muppets plus Walton Goggins in its own take on a Christmas carol — nostalgia and oddball charm in one spot.

stories.title: Google Sells Itself As A Commerce ‘Matchmaker,’ Not A Retailer
stories.take: Google is pitching itself to brands as a commerce 'matchmaker,' not a retailer — connecting shoppers to sellers rather than selling itself.

stories.title: Publicis installs leadership atop Marcel as agentic drives growth plans
stories.take: Publicis put new leadership atop Marcel as agentic AI drives its growth plans — the platform bet gets a fresh team.

stories.title: Thunder star Jalen Williams could miss remainder of season after breaking leg, dislocating ankle
stories.take: Brutal night for OKC: Jalen Williams broke his leg and dislocated an ankle Sunday and could miss the rest of the season — Cason Wallace needs surgery too, and Alex Caruso sprained an ankle. The defending champs are suddenly thin.

stories.title: More than a championship hangover: Four reasons behind Knicks' troubling 0-3 start
stories.take: The Knicks are 0-3, and it's more than a hangover — four structural reasons behind a start that's already raising alarms in New York.

stories.title: Magic's Suggs (knee) out at least 2 weeks, but no major damage
stories.take: Relief in Orlando: Jalen Suggs' scary-looking knee injury means at least two weeks out, but no major damage for the Magic.

stories.title: Sixers' Brown denies report he demanded trade from Celtics
stories.take: Jaylen Brown denied a report that he demanded a trade from Boston before landing with the Sixers — the rumor mill gets a firm no.

stories.title: NBA announces Kalshi, Polymarket partnerships
stories.take: The NBA announced partnerships with Kalshi and Polymarket — prediction markets are now officially inside the league's tent.

stories.title: U.S. senators call on NBA to reevaluate Rwanda partnership
stories.take: US senators called on the NBA to reevaluate its Rwanda partnership — political pressure on the league's Africa strategy is building.

stories.title: 2026 MLB playoff bracket: Schedule and scores with Brewers one win away from first World Series title
stories.take: Milwaukee is one win from its first World Series title after taking Game 3 in Tampa — the Brewers lead the Rays 3-0, and a first-time champion is guaranteed either way.

stories.title: Follow live: Brewers break Game 3 open with eight runs in fifth inning
stories.take: The fifth inning decided Game 3: Milwaukee hung eight runs on the Rays to break it open and put the series on the brink of a sweep.

stories.title: Mets' Lindor wins Roberto Clemente Award for humanitarian work
stories.take: Francisco Lindor won the Roberto Clemente Award for his humanitarian work — the Mets star takes home baseball's highest off-field honor.

stories.title: Brewers' Misiorowski unleashes 103.5 mph pitch to set World Series record
stories.take: Jacob Misiorowski threw 103.5 mph in this series, a World Series record — Milwaukee's flamethrower keeps rewriting the radar-gun book.

stories.title: Manfred: Small-market World Series good for game, but cap still needed
stories.take: Rob Manfred called a small-market Brewers-Rays World Series good for the game — then still argued baseball needs a salary cap.

stories.title: Dead grass era? MLB aids offense by testing restricted OF shifts
stories.take: MLB is testing restricted outfield shifts to juice offense — the league keeps tinkering with positioning to bring back hits.

stories.title: Justice department charges ex-FBI director James Comey for third time
stories.take: DOJ charged James Comey for a third time — two counts of leaking national-defense information allegedly from 2016, against one of Trump's most outspoken critics.

stories.title: Trump administration asks Washington to set aside hundreds of ballots from suspected noncitizen voters
stories.take: The Trump administration asked Washington state to set aside ballots from 400+ voters it alleges aren't citizens — the same move it made in California, in states that will decide control of Congress.

stories.title: Candidates enter final week of campaigning with control of Congress at stake
stories.take: Final week: candidates are sprinting with control of Congress at stake, and campaigns are spending big on increasingly personal attack ads.

stories.title: Lula prevails in Brazil but Flávio Bolsonaro refuses to concede
stories.take: Lula beat Trump-aligned Flávio Bolsonaro in Brazil — Bolsonaro refuses to concede and Trump called it 'rigged,' setting up a tense transition.

stories.title: Student-led movement ousts Serbia's right-wing ruler in historic election
stories.take: Serbia's student-led movement ousted longtime ruler Aleksandar Vučić in a historic election — protest energy turned into actual power.

stories.title: Netanyahu faces Israeli voters in first election since Oct. 7 and Gaza war
stories.take: Israel votes in its first election since Oct. 7 and the Gaza war, with Netanyahu reportedly pressuring the military over Iran in the run-up.

stories.title: FTC and 20 states sue Dollar General, accusing bargain chain of overcharging customers
stories.take: The FTC and 20 states sued Dollar General for persistently overcharging at 20,000+ stores — the case cites a Guardian investigation into inaccurate shelf pricing.

stories.title: Ukraine war briefing: Russia strikes Kyiv hours before truce begins in war-ravaged city Oleshky
stories.take: Russia struck Kyiv hours before a truce took hold in Oleshky, and Zelenskyy says Patriot interceptor stocks are dwindling while new supplies wait on Hegseth's sign-off.

stories.title: SoCal coast hit by widespread flooding as record-breaking tides move in
stories.take: Record-breaking tides are flooding the SoCal coast, with the highest water Monday through Wednesday — San Diego and Orange counties face road closures and inundated homes through Thursday.

stories.title: 9th Circuit denies feds' appeal over 20,000 ballots; district court hearing to proceed
stories.take: The 9th Circuit denied the feds' appeal over 20,000 California ballots — the case proceeds Tuesday before Judge Carter in Los Angeles.

stories.title: Guía de última hora para los votantes sobre las 14 propuestas en la boleta electoral de California
stories.take: CalMatters' last-minute voter guide walks through all 14 propositions on California's ballot — the $44B in bonds included — before you vote.

stories.title: A house divided? California YIMBYs disagree on Prop. 45
stories.take: Pro-housing groups are split on Prop. 45, which would limit CEQA reviews for 'essential' projects — does more housing here mean more sprawl?

stories.title: Former Bass opponent Rick Caruso now says he will vote for her reelection as mayor
stories.take: Rick Caruso, Karen Bass's former opponent, says he'll vote for her reelection — warning Raman would turn the LAPD into a 'laboratory for risky DSA social experimentation.'

stories.title: DSA's national leaders postpone decision on rescinding Raman's endorsement for mayor
stories.take: DSA's national leaders postponed a decision on rescinding Nithya Raman's LA mayoral endorsement — the fight over the race stays unresolved for now.

stories.title: Jumping Revenue, Big Losses and Many Risks: Inside Anthropic’s IPO Filing
stories.take: Anthropic's S-1 shows ~$16B revenue in six months (up 1,300% YoY) but losses over $80B from financing-related accounting • About 90 pages of the filing are risk factors — AI self-preservation, bioweapons, uninsurable catastrophic liability • Investors still call it must-own, with valuation talk up to $2T • Brazil's Bovespa fell over 13% after Lula's re-election

stories.title: What's in AI's next chapter?
stories.take: The answer: a payoff test — Anthropic (ticker ANT) filed to raise about $100B at a $1.5–2T valuation as the first pure-play AI listing, while Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon earnings this week must show AI capex turning into revenue • Anthropic's risk factors run 94 pages, including 'catastrophic or existential risks to humanity' • Microsoft is offering buyouts to 60,000 employees — a quarter of its workforce — to pay for AI • Helium joined the critical-materials list amid 'helium shortage 5.0'

stories.title: The DOJ wades into elections with unprecedented cases
stories.take: DOJ handed LA County a thumb drive with 20,000 names of alleged non-citizen voters and 48 hours to investigate, then sued California to segregate those ballots • More than 113 people charged nationwide — but a review of 64 cases found at least 56 are lawful permanent residents and only 4 are here illegally • DOJ also sued Alaska over two Dan Sullivans on the same ballot; experts across the spectrum call both suits unlikely to succeed • Roughly 1,000 DOJ election monitors head out this year

stories.title: Democrats find God
stories.take: Methodist megachurch pastor Adam Hamilton, a Democrat, is challenging Sen. Roger Marshall in deep-red Kansas — a state Trump won by 16+ points that is now an unexpected battleground • Hamilton calls himself 'pro-life with a heavy heart' while supporting legal abortion access, and campaigns on compassion and common ground • The race tests whether Democrats can win back religious voters after decades of the 'God gap' widening toward the GOP

stories.title: Leaderless student movement wins Serbian election
stories.take: Serbia's leaderless Student List won a clear majority — about 140 MPs drawn from doctors, academics and actors — ousting longtime leader Aleksandar Vučić • Lula won Brazil's runoff by more than 4 million votes after losing the first round • Israel heads into a pivotal election, and China's party meeting showed 44 empty military-commission chairs after Xi's purges

stories.title: What's next for China after Xi Jinping?
stories.take: The answer: Xi stays — he is likely to secure a fourth term, no successor has been named, and the next leaders will be officials born in the 1960s–70s and personally vetted by him • His anti-corruption purge removed five of seven Central Military Commission members, consolidating his control • Youth unemployment sits around 18%, and a struggling property sector is fueling public pessimism

stories.title: How the next LA Mayor could shakeup LA28, LAUSD meets to discuss school closures. UFO's on Catalina Island?— Afternoon Edition
stories.take: The answer on the UFOs: Pentagon files confirm a silver object sighted over Catalina Island in August 1952 by three Boy Scouts, with incidents dating to 1947 • Mayoral candidate Nithya Raman opposes the 2028 Olympics and would remove LAPD Chief Jim McDonald and install a financial monitor over LA28 spending • LAUSD starts new community meetings on school closures after enrollment fell more than 40% in two decades

stories.title: Costal flooding hits OC, LA Mayor calls LADWP audit,  Long Beach Unified cuts— Evening Edition
stories.take: Exceptionally high tides flooded Newport Beach and the Balboa Peninsula; the city is distributing sandbags • Mayor Bass called for an independent audit of LADWP rates after skyrocketing-bill complaints, plus a 25% boost to the energy-efficiency rebate program • Long Beach Unified voted to close Gompers and Edison elementary schools amid a $30M budget deficit
